title: L4-L5 nucleus pressure vs axial compression, in vitro reference (Brinckmann & Grootenboer 1991, re-plotted in Dreischarf 2014)

quantity.name: IDP
quantity.definition: absolute intradiscal (nucleus) pressure vs axial compressive force; median and range of 5 L4-L5 segments at 0, 300 and 1000 N (Fig 2d)

source.authors: Dreischarf M, Zander T, Shirazi-Adl A, Puttlitz CM, Adam CJ, Chen CS, Goel VK, Kiapour A, Kim YH, Labus KM, Little JP, Park WM, Wang YH, Wilke HJ, Rohlmann A, Schmidt H
source.sample: 5 specimens (L4-L5 segments, Brinckmann & Grootenboer 1991); human cadaveric L4-L5 motion segments, 5 (primary: Brinckmann P, Grootenboer H 1991, Spine 16:641-646)

protocol.summary: Axial compression 0-1000 N on L4-L5 segments; in the FE comparison compression applied as follower load (Section 2.4) to L1-L5 models.
how_to_simulate: Apply compression 0-1000 N (follower load in multi-segment models) with no moment
Read nucleus pressure in the L4-L5 disc
protocol.notes: Absolute IDP. Median line slope ~0.9 kPa/N (dashed line in Fig 2d, intercept ~0.04 MPa). Lower bound at 0 N not resolvable (at or near 0). Dreischarf text: 6 of 7 models within in vitro range at 1000 N; model 5 has 0.13 MPa offset at 0 N. Figures in the QUT eprints author version are low-resolution embedded bitmaps (~550x420 px for a 4-panel figure); digitised by pixel analysis of the extracted image against gridlines.

extraction.from: Fig 2d (black markers = median, red bars = range)
extraction.check_notes: Axis: top frame row 27.5 = 1.5 MPa, x-axis row 142 = 0; gridlines at 0.25-MPa steps confirmed at rows 123, 104, 85, 66. Markers re-read: 300 N rows 117-120 (0.31), 1000 N rows 68-72 (0.94); dashed median line points (53 N, 0.085) and (968 N, 0.910) interpolate to 0.31 at 300 N and 0.94 at 1000 N - consistent. verified 2026-11-12 independent check: OK (re-digitised Fig 2d p.11 markers/ranges within ±0.02 MPa; n=5 per caption)

pass_rule.rule: min <= model <= max at 300 and 1000 N
